# Test fixtures

`x-home-light.html` and `x-home-night.html` are **hand-built** pages generated by
`node tools/build-fixtures.mjs`. They follow the structure recorded in
`docs/x-dom-inventory.md`: the same `data-testid` values, roles and nesting, inline
colors written the way X writes them (`rgb(r, g, b)`), and react-native-web style
atomic rules (`rgba(r,g,b,1.00)`). They contain no real X content, usernames or
SVG paths; icons are a neutral placeholder square.

They are used by `tests/dom/fixtures.test.ts` (anchors, features, engine) and by the
visual tests in `tests/visual/`.

Real page snapshots can be added later with the development build's
**Take snapshot** popup button (it strips usernames, text, labels and images).
Save them here as `x-<page>-<theme>.real.html`; they are not used by default.
